issues.problem: ADVISORY: The code walkthrough puts both nested ConfigMap and Secret references on one long inline YAML line, and both annotations point to that same line. The references are correct, but the presentation makes the name/key paths unnecessarily difficult to inspect and distinguish.
issues.required_fix: Expand the env inline list into multiline YAML entries without changing any values: APP_MODE uses valueFrom.configMapKeyRef with name supplied-config and key mode; APP_TOKEN uses valueFrom.secretKeyRef with name supplied-secret and key token. Update the two annotation line ranges to their respective reference entries. Retain the explicit illustrative YAML/read-only framing and do not insert secret values.

issues.problem: ADVISORY: The self-contained practice prompt embeds the four-row, fifteen-column account/Region matrix as a single-line JSON code fence. Learners must repeatedly map positional array values back to a distant column list, which adds decoding work unrelated to account/Region verification. The snapshot agrees with the registry; this is a readability issue, not an answer-key defect.
issues.required_fix: Replace only the JSON fence in public.prompt with four labeled target records, one per target, using explicit field-name=value lines for every existing column. Preserve all registry values, distinguish null/not-applicable fields from confirmed absence, and retain the prompt's approved/unapproved scope, options and grading unchanged. Keep the evidence in the prompt so the standalone interaction remains self-contained.
